household.setupDescription: Create a new household or join an existing one to get started.
household.createSubtitle: Give your household a name. You'll get a code to share with others.
household.createCodeHelper: Share this code with anyone you want to invite. They can join from their profile.
household.joinSubtitle: Ask the household owner for their 7-character code and enter it below.
household.errorInvalidCode: Invalid join code. Please check and try again.
household.errorAlreadyMember: You're already a member of this household.
household.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.closeHouseholdDescription: Permanently deletes this household and all its data for every member. This cannot be undone.
settings.closeHouseholdModalBody: This will permanently delete {name} and remove all members. All menus, shopping lists, and history will be lost.
settings.closeHouseholdWarning: This action cannot be undone. All {count} members will lose access immediately.
settings.closeError: Failed to close household. Please try again.
settings.leaveHouseholdDescription: You'll lose access to shared menus and shopping lists. The household continues for other members.
settings.leaveHouseholdModalBody: You'll lose access to shared menus and shopping lists. The household continues for other members.
settings.leaveError: Failed to leave household. Please try again.
settings.nameTooLong: Household name must be 50 characters or less.
settings.nameError: Failed to update name. Please try again.
